title: Talks, Lemi Orhan Ergin
description: Conferences, meetups, universities and webinars where Lemi Orhan Ergin has spoken, year by year, with slides and recordings where they exist.

head.heading: Talks

blocks.alt: Lemi on stage presenting to a full conference room

blocks.text: I speak about software craftsmanship, engineering culture, agile without the ceremony, and Git. Over the years that has meant conferences across Europe and the Middle East, more than 200 seminars at companies and universities, and many community meetups.

blocks: Below are the conferences, meetups, universities and webinars I could trace, newest first. Slides are on [Speaker Deck](https://speakerdeck.com/lemiorhan) and recordings on [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQTv1b9jwvWdvUVfv0M55mRbTB8CMYT9R). Some talks left no slides or recording behind. They are listed too. Organizers will find a [speaker bio](#bio) at the end of the page.

talks.title: How AI Is Changing Our Software Development Culture
talks.summary: AI does not transform a team, it amplifies it: the roles of developers, teams and leaders shift, and trust has to be built outside the model, in tests and verification.

photo.alt: Lemi and the host standing on stage in conversation, the session title and both speakers on the screen behind

talks.title: When Code Becomes Disposable...
talks.summary: AI makes code cheap to write and harder to trust. On regenerative software, where the implementation can be rebuilt and the behavior survives.

talks.title: Software Development in the Age of AI: Redefining Architecture, Quality and Culture

talks.title: Rebirth of Software Craftsmanship in the AI Era
talks.summary: AI makes developers braver, not faster: as code turns cheap, the craft moves to verification, domain knowledge, modularity and the decisions behind the code.

photo.alt: A full hotel ballroom watching Lemi's keynote, the talk title on two screens

talks.title: Product Developer: From Writing Code to Building Products

talks.title: “We Have Tests” Is Not Enough: Unit Testing for Reliable Code

blocks.text: Lemi Orhan Ergin is a software crafter based in Istanbul and the co-founder and Chief Software Crafter of Craftgate, a payment orchestration platform. He has been programming since 2001 and has held technical leadership and coaching roles at Sony, eBay/GittiGidiyor, ACM and iyzico. He founded the Software Craftsmanship Turkey community in 2014, has organized more than 200 meetups, and hosts the Turkish podcast Lemi'nin Not Defteri.
